title: A fraction of a fraction
summary: Understand what 'a fraction of a fraction' means and learn the multiplication rule.

blocks.body: A fraction of a quantity means multiplication. Therefore, a fraction of another fraction is also multiplication: multiply the numerators together and multiply the denominators together.
Multiply across: 2 x 5 = 10 and 3 x 7 = 21. The result is 10/21.

blocks.title: A useful picture
blocks.body: If a rectangle is divided into sevenths and you take two-thirds of those sevenths, you keep 2 of 3 equal groups of 5 sevenths. That is 10 of 21 equal parts.
Always simplify the final fraction when possible. For example, 3/4 of 2/9 becomes 6/36, which simplifies to 1/6.
Sometimes a fraction has a whole number on one side of the fraction bar and a fraction on the other. Read the large fraction bar as division.
When the fraction is on top and the whole number is on the bottom, divide the fraction by the whole number.
If both the top and bottom are fractions, use the same rule: keep the top fraction, change division to multiplication, and flip the bottom fraction.

blocks.title: Before you calculate
blocks.body: Estimate the result. Multiplying two proper fractions should give a positive number smaller than either fraction.
